com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Approve one reviewed invoice after required checks and approval steps. Approval can queue a bill in a connected accounting system when automatic export is enabled. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview approving the invoice we reviewed, with the note: Compared with source. Show remaining blockers and whether approval can queue a bill in our accounting system through automatic export. Wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_approve_invoice, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare approval of one reviewed invoice. Requires confirmation, current approval authority, no blocking validation errors and cleared approval workflows. Does not itself bypass accounting export safeguards.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
